notes: Adds Playnite.Core.Library.PagedLibraryReader, PagedLibraryQuery and PagedLibraryComparer: one SQLite snapshot with ORDER BY, LIMIT and OFFSET in SQL, a required bounded limit, and the stored identity text as the final ascending tie-breaker. Pages load only the requested game graphs, not the full library; an instrumented session seam proves a page of N reads only the N-row window. Text keys use SQLite NOCASE and PagedLibraryComparer is the exact in-memory mirror, including the stored-text identity tie-break; numeric, date and flag orders match LibraryService. Wired via p6-001: LibraryService delegates an unfiltered, ungrouped list and a blank or null search to this reader, so list/search read only the requested window instead of the full snapshot; GameRepository stays unchanged. Filters, v10 text search with a real term and grouping remain p6-001/p6-011 and use the same NOCASE comparer in memory.
